content: सत्त्वम् [सतो भावः] (Said to be {%m.%} also in the first ten senses) .²1 Being, existence, entity. .²2 Nature, essence. .²3 Natural character, inborn disposition; अच्योष्ट सत्त्वान्नृपतिश्च्युताशः <ls>Bk. 3. 20</ls>. .²4 Life, spirit, breath, vitality, principle of vitality; उद्गतानीव सत्त्वानि वभूवुरमनस्विनाम् <ls>Rām. 2. 48. 2</ls>; चित्रे निवेश्य परिकल्पितसत्त्वयोगा <ls>Ś. 2. 10</ls>. .²5 Consciousness, mind, sense; वाक्च सत्त्वं च गोविन्द बुद्धौ संवेशितानि ते <ls>Mb. 12. 46. 4</ls>; <ls>Bg. 16. 1</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 41</ls>. .²6 An embryo. .²7 Substance, thing, wealth. .²8 An elementary substance such as earth, air, fire <ab>&c.</ab> .²9 (also {%m.%}) A living or sentient being, animal, beast; वन्यान् विनेष्यन्निव दुष्टसत्त्वान् <ls>R. 2. 8</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 15</ls>; किं नोऽपत्यनिर्विशेषाणि सत्त्वानि विप्रकरोषि <ls>Ś. 7</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9</ls>; यश्चासूनपि संत्यजेत् करुणया सत्त्वार्थमभ्युद्यतः <ls>Nāg. 2. 10</ls>. .²10 An evil spirit, a demon, ghost; अद्य नूनं दशरथः सत्त्वमाविश्य भाषते <ls>Rām. 2. 33. 10</ls>. .²11 Goodness, virtue, excellence. .²12 Truth, reality, certainty. .²13 Strength, energy, courage, vigour, power, inherent power, the stuff of which a person is made; निजमेव सत्त्वमुपकारि सताम् <ls>Ki. 18. 14</ls>; <ls>Mb. 12. 313. 17</ls>; क्रियासिद्धिः सत्त्वे भवति महतां नोपकरणे <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 31</ls>; <ls>Mu. 3. 22</ls>. .²14 Wisdom, good sense. .²15 The quality of goodness or purity regarded as the highest of the three Guṇas <ab>q. v.</ab>; (it is said to predominate most in gods and heavenly beings). .²16 A natural property or quality, characteristic. .²17 A noun, substantive. .²18 Intellect (बुद्धि); अघ्राणमवितर्कं च सत्त्वं प्रविशते परम् <ls>Mb. 12. 204. 18</ls>. .²19 The subtle body or individual soul (लिङ्गशरीर); गृहाणीव हि मर्त्यानामाहुर्देहानि पण्डिताः . कालेन विनियुज्यन्ते सत्त्वमेकं तु शाश्वतम् .. <ls>Mb. 11. 3. 8</ls>.
